scope: deterministic character preset loadout skill-name reconciliation against canonical skills.json
methodology: Compared every skill-slot string in the 25 currently verified preset loadouts against canonical skill record names using exact case-insensitive identity matching. A normalized punctuation/spacing pass was also tested for unmatched entries and produced no additional matches. No alias, character-only, or historical identity was inferred.
interpretation: All 162 verified preset skill-slot references resolve to exact canonical skill identities. The 18 identities added during reconciliation remain marked partially_verified/catalog_gap_promoted and require subsequent provenance/mechanics enrichment; they were not treated as verified_current_scope merely because they occur in preset loadouts.
next: Enrich and independently reconcile the 18 catalog-gap-promoted records against their existing repository research batches, correcting acquisition/classification/mechanics fields where direct evidence is available and preserving null/conflict boundaries.
promotion_note: The final unmatched Shockwave reference was promoted using existing repository research batch 134, which explicitly establishes its Super / Strike identity, 100 Ki cost, Skill Shop acquisition, CaC availability, and current provenance. No unsupported mechanics or probability fields were added.

research_reconciliation.method: Repository search for each unmatched preset skill name, followed by direct inspection of representative skill-research batches. Research/index layers are evidence only; no canonical identity is promoted from them without record-level reconciliation.
research_reconciliation.conclusion: The unmatched preset references are not a single error class. Most have existing repository research records and can be reconciled against the canonical schema; Galaxy Breaker (Festival) is explicitly non-CaC in current research and should remain outside the CaC canonical corpus. Shockwave and several repeated names require identity/dedup review before mutation. Super Ki Explosion and Ultra Fighting Bomber still lack repository research-batch evidence and must not be synthesized.

reconciliation_2026_09_27.verification_policy: Identity coverage may be reconciled into canonical records, but verification_status remains partially_verified until record-level evidence is reconciled. reconciliation_2026_09_27.evidence_boundary: Existing research batches are evidence; canonical skills.json remains the source of truth. No verified/index/projection layer is treated as authoritative.
